title: Probing Charge and Spin Order in Ferroic Materials with Time-Resolved Electron Microscopy
content: Ferroic materials, such as ferroelectrics and ferromagnets, exhibit long-range charge or spin order that can be switched by external stimuli, making them promising candidates for energy-efficient microelectronics. Recent advances in electron microscopy have significantly enhanced our understanding of these materials by enabling direct imaging of lattice, charge, and spin configurations, as well as their dynamic switching behavior at the atomic scale.
